title: fix(cli): schema migration takes a cluster-wide lock so concurrent replicas cannot migrate at once (#3814)
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Parent: #3814 (rulings R0-R6 on comment 6722625146).

## Problem (fable plan review #2, card 0)
The Helm chart runs the schema migration as an init container in every pod, with no lock, so N replicas starting together run N concurrent migrations (`pg_type` collisions seen in the field class). Compose uses a one-shot service and is not exposed.

## Do
1. `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`: take a database advisory lock (Postgres `pg_advisory_lock`, MySQL `GET_LOCK`; SQLite needs none) around the migration, with a bounded wait and one log line while waiting; the second migrator then finds nothing to do.
2. The lock is harmless on a single node (uncontended); keep its output identical apart from no new lines when uncontended. Note: this changes the single-node code path by one uncontended lock call; say so in the PR.
3. Tests: two concurrent migrations against one Postgres: one waits, both succeed, the schema is applied once.
4. The Helm hook Job is the cloud C2 card's; do not touch `helm/`.

## Rules that bind every #3814 child (verbatim rulings on the parent)
R1 peer round-robin. R2 Redis required for multi-replica only. R3 「同意：每张卡都只在"声明多副本并接上 Redis 驱动"时才生效」: the single-node default path is unchanged, multi-replica behaviour switches on only behind declared replicas>1 AND a connected Redis cluster driver, the split-brain guard is never weakened, and the deploy README "multi-node unsupported" line stays until the final gate.

## Done when
PR merged; concurrent migrations serialize; single-node migration output unchanged.
